content.text: Explore the best of Shillong and Lum 'er Pyngngad (Mini Pahalgam) on a scenic one-day tour. This tour package lets the visitors dive into the picturesque landscapes, charming attractions, pine-covered hills and the soothing beauty that makes it a must-visit destination. Also, discover the breathtaking beauty of Shillong and its best attractions. Our Shillong and Lum 'er Pyngngad one day tour is best for families, nature lovers and friends group and offers a refreshing glance of some of Shillong's most captivating attractions and hidden gems.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Explore the Lum 'er Pyngngad widely known as the 'Mini Pahalgam of Meghalaya'
Discover the breathtaking beauty of Umiam Lake along the way
Visit the Don Bosco Museum and explore the rich cultural heritage of Meghalaya
Explore the scenic beauty of Ward's Lake

main.title: Shillong & Lum 'er Pyngngad (Mini Pahalgam) One-Day Sightseeing Tour Itinerary

items: You will be received by our representative on your arrival at Guwahati.

Your Shillong & Lum 'er Pyngngad (Mini Pahalgam) One-Day Sightseeing Tour begins with a drive to Lum 'er Pyngngad also known as Mini Pahalgam of Meghalaya. It will take around 2 hours to reach this scenic destination from Guwahati.

On reaching Lum 'er Pyngngad, you will be witnessing the grassy landscapes, tall pine trees, splendid views of Umiam Lake and a breathtaking atmosphere. Spend a relaxing time here. You can also engage in photography, pony-ride, and enjoy the delicious food as well.

After spending a quality time at this beautiful destination, head towards Shillong. On the way to Shillong, discover the famous Umiam lake. Enjoy the amazing views at this spot and you can also take some beautiful snaps at this place.
Later, proceed to the Don Bosco Museum which is the centre of Meghalaya's rich tradition and heritage. This place is a perfect spot for history enthusiasts and is a must visit when in Shillong.
If time permits, your last destination of the day will be the Ward's Lake. You can spend a refreshing time here engaging yourself in the scenic walk or simply adoring the serene atmosphere.
Later, you'll be dropped back to Guwahati Airport or Railway Station which will mark the end of your amazing Shillong & Lum 'er Pyngngad (Mini Pahalgam) One-Day Sightseeing Tour.
